method: Same-session Node attribution diagnostic, baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order. Fresh Node process per run executes the unchanged complete readiness-node planning and refresh workload, bundled as ESM with esbuild. Only definition.js is replaced in the baseline bundle with transpiled HEAD source. Bundling differs from the formal unbundled Node run, so this diagnoses the observed regression rather than replacing formal measurements.

timingContract.planning: SDL parsing/inspection, binding and public operation preparation measured separately
timingContract.refresh: wall time includes operation planning, local GraphQL execute, decode/commit and subscriber projections
timingContract.remainder: wall minus local execute; includes scheduling and all client work, not a direct cache-only measurement
timingContract.statistics: individual samples and min/median/max; no small-sample tail-percentile claims
